# Test Plan

<!-- Generated By: Claude Code (claude-opus-5-5[1m]) -->

> This document describes the testing strategy for this project. It serves as the single source of truth for testing decisions and rationale.

## Overview

- **Project:** ap-discover-targetname
- **Primary functionality:** Append `OBJECT_<target>` to the filenames of LIGHT frames that have no target, using the nearest reference target by mount RA/DEC.

## Testing Philosophy

This project follows the [Testing Standards](https://github.com/jewzaam/standards/blob/main/python/testing.md).

Key testing principles for this project:

- Matching and renaming are tested on in-memory metadata dicts, the same shape ap-common returns, so no FITS files are needed
- Renames happen on placeholder files in `tmp_path`; a `conftest.py` guard fails any test that calls `os.rename` outside `tmp_path`
- ap-common metadata loading is mocked; tests verify the arguments passed to it, not ap-common itself

## Shared Test Data

All tests in `tests/test_discover_targetname.py`.

| Name | Definition |
|------|------------|
| `REFERENCE` | `{"Cocoon Nebula": (328.4, 47.27), "North America Nebula": (314.7, 44.53)}`, two targets about 10° apart |
| Raw layout | `RAW/<rig>/DATE_<date>/<frame>`, matching raw capture with the target directory removed. Primary rig `SQA55@f5.3+AP26CC`, secondary rig `Raptor@f4.5+XSi` |
| `make_datum(filename, ra="328.4", dec="47.27", targetname=None)` | Normalized metadata dict: `filename`, `type=LIGHT`, `ra`, `dec`, `targetname`. Defaults sit exactly on the Cocoon Nebula center |
| `make_reference_datum(name, ...)` | `make_datum` with filename `F:/RAW/SQA55@f5.3+AP26CC/DATE_2026-10-14/<name>`. Metadata only, no file: reference frames are never renamed |
| `make_frame(tmp_path, name=..., date="2026-10-14")` | Creates a 4-byte placeholder file (`b"fits"`) at `<tmp_path>/RAW/Raptor@f4.5+XSi/DATE_<date>/<name>`. Default name `2026-10-14_08-12-10_HFR_2.77_RMSAC_0.00_TEMP_26.00.fits` |

## Untested Areas

| Area | Reason Not Tested |
|------|-------------------|
| Header reading and normalization (`RA`/`DEC` → `ra`/`dec`, `OBJECT` → `targetname`/`panel`) | Tested in ap-common; tests use dicts in the shape ap-common returns |
| Real FITS/XISF files | No header I/O in this project; covered by ap-common |
| Recursive file discovery under the rig directory | `get_filtered_metadata` is mocked; tests assert `recursive=True` is passed and that renames stay in each frame's own directory |
| Filename parsing of the appended `OBJECT_<target>` by downstream tools | Behavior of ap-common `get_file_headers`; traced, not tested here |

## Bug Fix Testing Protocol

All bug fixes to existing functionality **must** follow TDD:

1. Write a failing test that exposes the bug
2. Verify the test fails before implementing the fix
3. Implement the fix
4. Verify the test passes
5. Verify reverting the fix causes the test to fail again
6. Commit test and fix together with issue reference

## Coverage Goals

**Target:** 80%+ line coverage (enforced by `make test-coverage`)

**Philosophy:** Coverage measures completeness, not quality. A test that executes code without meaningful assertions provides no value. Focus on:

- Testing behavior, not implementation details
- Covering edge cases and error conditions
- Ensuring assertions verify expected outcomes

## Running Tests

```bash
# Run all tests
make test-unit

# Run with coverage
make test-coverage

# Run specific test
python -m pytest tests/test_discover_targetname.py::TestAssignFrame::test_renames_matched_frame
```

## Test Data

All test data is generated in the tests: metadata dicts and 4-byte placeholder files in `tmp_path`. No `tests/fixtures/`.

**No Git LFS** - all test data must be small (< 100KB) or generated.

## Maintenance

When modifying this project:

1. **Adding features**: Add tests for new functionality after implementation
2. **Fixing bugs**: Follow TDD protocol above (test first, then fix)
3. **Refactoring**: Existing tests should pass without modification (behavior unchanged)
4. **Removing features**: Remove associated tests
